pairs.target: shū yàn bǎ yàoshi chā jìnmén lǐ , zhuǎn le liǎngxià , cái xiǎngqǐ ménshuān hái zài lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: Shuyan inserted the key and turned it twice before remembering the bolt was still fastened inside.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚把钥匙插进门里，转了两下，才想起门栓还在里面。

pairs.target: tā cóng pángbiān fènglǐ shēnjìn yìgēn biǎn mùpiàn , jiāng shuān mànmàn tiāokāi , huítóu kànjiàn tǎ wéi dīng zhe yàoshi , biàn xiào dào :
pairs.english: She slid a flat piece of wood through the crack beside it and slowly lifted the bolt. Turning to see Tavi staring at the key, she laughed:
pairs.hanzi: 她从旁边缝里伸进一根扁木片，将栓慢慢挑开，回头看见塔维盯着钥匙，便笑道：

pairs.target: " guà zhe shì gěi rén kàn de . zhēn suǒshàng le , lǐtou hái zěnme liàng dōngxī ? "
pairs.english: “It's hanging there for show. If it were really locked, how would anyone dry things inside?”
pairs.hanzi: “挂着是给人看的。真锁上了，里头还怎么晾东西？”

pairs.target: mén hòu guǒrán guà zhe liǎngzhāng cháng xí , biānjiǎo dī zhe zuóyè xǐ guò de shuǐ . tāmen cèshēn chuān guòqù , cái jiàndào nàtiáo yán shíbì xiàngshàng de zhǎi tī .
pairs.english: Sure enough, two long mats hung behind the door, their corners dripping water from last night's washing. They edged sideways past them to find the narrow stair climbing along the stone wall.
pairs.hanzi: 门后果然挂着两张长席，边角滴着昨夜洗过的水。他们侧身穿过去，才见到那条沿石壁向上的窄梯。

pairs.target: zhè shì tōngwǎng jiù hú cèmiàn de jiǎnxiū lù , gēn fēng zhù de cháng kuà búshì yìtiáo dào .
pairs.english: This maintenance path led to the side of the old arch, separate from the closed long span.
pairs.hanzi: 这是通往旧弧侧面的检修路，跟封住的长跨不是一条道。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng lái qián yǐjīng xiàng shǒu lù de rén wèn guò , jīnrì zhī dào shàngmiàn de hòu xíng wū , ménwài zài yuǎn biàn bùxǔ zǒu .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng had checked with the path keeper before coming: today they could go only to the waiting house above, no farther beyond its door.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡来前已经向守路的人问过，今日只到上面的候行屋，门外再远便不许走。

pairs.target: yù hé xiān shàng , suíshēndài xiǎo chǐ hé huàbǎn , tǎ wéi bèizhe kōng zhǐtǒng gēn zài hòutou .
pairs.english: Yuhe went first with a small ruler and drawing board. Tavi followed, carrying an empty paper tube on his back.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾先上，随身带小尺和画板，塔维背着空纸筒跟在后头。

pairs.target: cóng xià tóu kàn , hòu xíng wū xiàng tiē zài shízhù páng de yìzhī xiǎo xiázǐ .
pairs.english: From below, the waiting house looked like a little box stuck beside the stone pier.
pairs.hanzi: 从下头看，候行屋像贴在石柱旁的一只小匣子。

pairs.target: zhēn dào jìnchù , wūyán què kuān dé néng ràng shíjǐgè rén bìngpái bìyǔ , shíbì shàng liú zhe chángdèng chāi qù hòu de fāngkǒng , ménpáng háiyǒu bàngè xié xiàng de cáo .
pairs.english: Up close, though, its eaves could shelter a dozen people side by side. Square holes in the stone wall marked removed benches, and half a slanting groove remained beside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 真到近处，屋檐却宽得能让十几个人并排避雨，石壁上留着长凳拆去后的方孔，门旁还有半个斜向的槽。

pairs.target: yǒurén ná tā chā guò sàozhou , cáo dǐ jī zhe duàn zhúsī .
pairs.english: Someone had used it to hold a broom; broken bamboo fibers had collected at its base.
pairs.hanzi: 有人拿它插过扫帚，槽底积着断竹丝。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng jìnmén shí hái juéde mēn , děng zhuǎnguò qiángjiǎo , kànjiàn wàimiàn de tiān , jiǎo què xiān tíng le .
pairs.english: Tavi had felt stifled on entering, but when he rounded the corner and saw the open sky, his feet stopped first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚进门时还觉得闷，等转过墙角，看见外面的天，脚却先停了。

pairs.target: xià tóu de jiē xiàng jǐgēn dā zài yìqǐ de xiàn . zuótiān tì mài bù gūniáng nuó guò de péng zhī shèng xiǎoxiǎo yíkuài lán , hémiàn bèi wūdǐng qièchéng jǐpiàn , yuǎn pō de tītián yìcéng bǐ yìcéng dàn .
pairs.english: The streets below looked like threads laid together. Yesterday's cloth seller's awning was only a tiny patch of blue, roofs divided the river into pieces, and terraces on the far slope faded layer by layer.
pairs.hanzi: 下头的街像几根搭在一起的线。昨天替卖布姑娘挪过的棚只剩小小一块蓝，河面被屋顶切成几片，远坡的梯田一层比一层淡。

pairs.target: jiù hú cóng yòushǒu de shízuò shēngqǐ , yuèguò tāmen tóudǐng , lìngyìduān cáng jìn gāochù de yúnyǐng , xiàng yídào bùkěn shùnzhe shānshì zǒu de shānjǐ .
pairs.english: The old arch rose from the stone base to their right, crossed overhead and vanished into cloud shadow at its far end, like a ridge refusing to follow the mountain's contours.
pairs.hanzi: 旧弧从右手的石座升起，越过他们头顶，另一端藏进高处的云影，像一道不肯顺着山势走的山脊。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào zhèlǐ yǒu hùlán , háishì shēnshǒu fú le ménkuàng . zhǐtǒng zài bèihòu qīngqīng pèng qiáng , shēngyīn ràng tā juéde zìjǐ yòu zhàn le yìdiǎn shízài de dìfāng .
pairs.english: He knew there was a railing, but still reached for the doorframe. The tube tapped the wall behind him, its sound making him feel he occupied a little solid space again.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道这里有护栏，还是伸手扶了门框。纸筒在背后轻轻碰墙，声音让他觉得自己又占了一点实在的地方。

pairs.target: yù hé méi jiào tā kuài xiē , zìjǐ zài ménbiān dūnxià , xiān huà quē diào de nàduàn dèng jiǎo .
pairs.english: Yuhe did not hurry him; she crouched by the door and first drew the missing length of bench supports.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾没叫他快些，自己在门边蹲下，先画缺掉的那段凳脚。

pairs.target: shū yàn jiāng xí shàng dīxià de shuǐ zhǐ gěi ruǎn héng kàn , shuō zhù xià tóu de rén dānxīn wūdǐng lòushuǐ , cái tuō tā shànglái kànkàn ; bié guāng kàn wàitou de dà dōngxī , huíqù réng shuōbùqīng shuǐ cóng shuíjiā liú .
pairs.english: Shuyan pointed out the dripping mats to Ruan Heng. The residents below had asked her up because they feared roof leaks; he should not stare only at grand things outside and return still unable to say whose house the water came from.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚将席上滴下的水指给阮衡看，说住下头的人担心屋顶漏水，才托她上来看看；别光看外头的大东西，回去仍说不清水从谁家流。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zuǐlǐ yìng zhe , yǐjīng zǒu dào lìng yíshàn chuāngqián . nàlǐ duì zhe kōng chù , chuāng xià què liú zhe yídào móguāng de shí kǎn , bǐ pǔtōng chuāngtái kuān xǔduō .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng answered while already walking to another window. It faced empty air, but a worn stone sill remained beneath it, much broader than an ordinary windowsill.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡嘴里应着，已经走到另一扇窗前。那里对着空处，窗下却留着一道磨光的石槛，比普通窗台宽许多。

pairs.target: tā gé zhe lán liáng le chǐcùn , méiyǒu kuàchūqù .
pairs.english: He measured from behind the railing without stepping out.
pairs.hanzi: 他隔着栏量了尺寸，没有跨出去。

pairs.target: " zhèbiān yǐqián yě néng jìnlái ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Could people come in this way before too?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “这边以前也能进来？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " xiàngshì . " ruǎn héng shuō , " cóng nǎlǐ jìn , dé zhǎo jiù tú . "
pairs.english: “Looks like it,” Ruan Heng said. “We need old plans to see from where.”
pairs.hanzi: “像是。”阮衡说，“从哪里进，得找旧图。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shùnzhe tā de shìxiàn wǎng xià kàn . chuāngwài jǐgēn cūdà de zhīzuò zhī shèng bànjié , duànmiàn hēibáixiāngjiàn , xiàmiàn méiyǒu rújīn néng jiēdào de lù .
pairs.english: Tavi followed his gaze down. Outside the window, only stumps of thick supports remained, their broken faces mottled black and white; no present road connected below.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维顺着他的视线往下看。窗外几根粗大的支座只剩半截，断面黑白相间，下面没有如今能接到的路。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngxiàng yíjià dàchē tíng zài bànkōng , yòu juéde bú duì ; nàme gāo de dìfāng , shēngkǒu zěnme shànglái , chē yòu wǎng nǎbiān zhuǎn ?
pairs.english: He pictured a large cart suspended in the air, then doubted it: how would animals get so high, and where would the cart turn?
pairs.hanzi: 他想象一架大车停在半空，又觉得不对；那么高的地方，牲口怎么上来，车又往哪边转？

pairs.target: tā wèn ruǎn héng , duìfāng shuō zìjǐ yě xiǎng zhīdào , yǔqì lǐ yǒu yìdiǎn méi yǎnzhù de xīngfèn .
pairs.english: He asked Ruan Heng, who said he wanted to know too, a little undisguised excitement in his voice.
pairs.hanzi: 他问阮衡，对方说自己也想知道，语气里有一点没掩住的兴奋。

pairs.target: shū yàn zài hòutou tíxǐng , bié xiǎngzhe ná xízi dā yízuò lù chūqù kàn .
pairs.english: Shuyan reminded him from behind not to try building a path out of mats for a closer look.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚在后头提醒，别想着拿席子搭一座路出去看。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng huítóu shuō nàme báo de xízi chéng búzhù rén , yù hé lìjí jiē dào : " tā búshì zài gēn nǐ tǎolùn hòubáo . "
pairs.english: Ruan Heng turned and said such thin mats could not carry anyone. Yuhe immediately added, “She isn't discussing thickness with you.”
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡回头说那么薄的席子承不住人，郁禾立即接道：“她不是在跟你讨论厚薄。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào dé wàng le jiǎodǐ de kōng .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed and forgot the empty air beneath his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑得忘了脚底的空。

pairs.target: tā yán qiáng tuìhuí yīnyǐng lǐ , zài lìngyícè fāxiàn sāndào duǎn kèhén , pángbiān yǒu bèi módiào de zì .
pairs.english: He backed along the wall into shadow and found three short incised marks on the other side, with worn-away writing beside them.
pairs.hanzi: 他沿墙退回阴影里，在另一侧发现三道短刻痕，旁边有被磨掉的字。

pairs.target: kèhén yìgāoyìdī , xiàng tā zài xià tóu shízuò jiàn guò de shuǐxiàn , què bù cháo hé , yě bú zài tóng yímiàn .
pairs.english: The marks were at different heights, like waterlines he had seen on the stone base below, yet faced neither the river nor the same side.
pairs.hanzi: 刻痕一高一低，像他在下头石座见过的水线，却不朝河，也不在同一面。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ gěi yù hé , tā kàn le kàn , jiào tā huà xià wèizhì , bié xiān xiěchéng shuǐwèi .
pairs.english: He pointed them out to Yuhe. After looking, she told him to draw their positions without labeling them water levels yet.
pairs.hanzi: 他指给郁禾，她看了看，叫他画下位置，别先写成水位。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ wūlǐ jǐchù kǒng cáo hé chuāng kǎn gè huà yìzhāng , shū yàn yòng zhǐtou zài zhǐ shàng diǎn chū lòushuǐ chù , yāoqiú bié ná wàitou de duàn zuò bǎ tā zhē diào .
pairs.english: They drew the room's holes, grooves and window sill separately. Shuyan pointed to the leak on the paper, insisting the broken supports outside must not obscure it.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把屋里几处孔槽和窗槛各画一张，舒砚用指头在纸上点出漏水处，要求别拿外头的断座把它遮掉。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènzhēn lìng huà le yìjiǎo , lián liǎngzhāng liàng xí yě huà le jìnqù .
pairs.english: Tavi carefully drew a separate detail, including even the two drying mats.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认真另画了一角，连两张晾席也画了进去。

pairs.target: huíchéng shí , tā yǐjīng néng yìbiān fú zhe lán , yìbiān wǎng yuǎnchù kàn . yún wǎng gǔ lǐ yā le yìdiǎn , jiù hú lìngyìduān réng kàn bù quán .
pairs.english: On the way back, he could already look into the distance while holding the railing. Clouds had settled a little lower into the valley, still hiding part of the arch's far end.
pairs.hanzi: 回程时，他已经能一边扶着栏，一边往远处看。云往谷里压了一点，旧弧另一端仍看不全。

pairs.target: tā hūrán xiǎngdào zìjǐ zài bái jiē chángláng lǐ tòuguò wàng jìng kàn chángfēng qiáo , mǐlā shuō nàlǐ yǒu tā fùqīn xiū guò de qiáomiàn , yīwén ná zhe yìzhāng méi xiě quán de tú zhēngbiàn .
pairs.english: He suddenly remembered looking at Longwind Bridge through the telescope in the White Steps gallery: Mira spoke of the deck her father had repaired, and Iven argued with an incomplete diagram in hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他忽然想到自己在白阶长廊里透过望镜看长风桥，米拉说那里有她父亲修过的桥面，伊文拿着一张没写全的图争辩。

pairs.target: nàshí sāngè nǎodài jǐ zài yìqǐ , shuí yě bùkěn xiān ràngkāi jìngtǒng .
pairs.english: Back then three heads had crowded together, none willing to yield the telescope first.
pairs.hanzi: 那时三个脑袋挤在一起，谁也不肯先让开镜筒。

pairs.target: yǎnxià zhèlǐ kōng dé hěn , zhǐtǒng yě qīng , tā què xiǎng huíqù duō mǎi liǎngzhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: Now the place felt very empty and his tube was light, yet he wanted to buy two more sheets of paper when he got back.
pairs.hanzi: 眼下这里空得很，纸筒也轻，他却想回去多买两张纸。

pairs.target: ruò zhī xiě " dà dé bùdéliǎo ", yīwén yídìng huì huíxìn wèn dàodǐ yǒu duō dà , mǐlā gèng huì zhíjiē zài pángbiān huà yígè wènhào .
pairs.english: If he only wrote “unbelievably huge,” Iven would certainly write back asking exactly how huge, and Mira would simply draw a question mark beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 若只写“大得不得了”，伊文一定会回信问到底有多大，米拉更会直接在旁边画一个问号。

pairs.target: dào xiàmiàn nà shàn ménqián , shū yàn xiān kàn le kàn xí jiǎo , jiāng mùshuān chóngxīn bō shàng .
pairs.english: At the door below, Shuyan first checked the mat corners and slid the wooden bolt back into place.
pairs.hanzi: 到下面那扇门前，舒砚先看了看席角，将木栓重新拨上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng tā guà hǎo nà bǎ méiyòng shàng de yàoshi , cái wèn míngrì néng bunéng jiè dào jiù tú .
pairs.english: Tavi waited until she hung up the unused key, then asked whether they could borrow old plans tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等她挂好那把没用上的钥匙，才问明日能不能借到旧图。

pairs.target: " dé xiān zhǎodào guǎn tú de rén . " tā shuō , " tā jīntiān yě zài chūn shì . wǒ ruò zhīdào tā zài nǎgè tānzi , jiù búyòng pǎoshànglái tì tā liàng xí le . "
pairs.english: “We first have to find the plans keeper,” she said. “He's at the spring market today too. If I knew which stall, I wouldn't have had to come up here and dry his mats for him.”
pairs.hanzi: “得先找到管图的人。”她说，“他今天也在春市。我若知道他在哪个摊子，就不用跑上来替他晾席了。”
